metadata.title: UnattendXmlBuilder
metadata.description: Module for building Windows unattend XML documents.

findings.title: PowerShell syntax could not be parsed
Separate username and password parameters are declared
findings.description: Function 'New-UnattendBuilder' has both Username and Password parameters. Either set the type of the Password parameter to SecureString or replace the Username and Password parameters with a Credential parameter of type PSCredential. If using a Credential parameter in PowerShell 4.0 or earlier, please define a credential transformation attribute after the PSCredential type attribute.
